row.notes: Applies simulated tyre wear in red-flag unlap: takes the 4 tyre wear values (+0xc/+0x18/+0x24/+0x30 of the current set), shifts them so the worst equals this+0xb58 and clamps to 0..1. Callers: Sess_RedFlag_SimulateUnlapLaps.

verify.notes: V3750 Tyre-wear shift (4 values +0xc/+0x18/+0x24/+0x30, worst -> +0xb58, clamp 0..1) correct, but it also clamps/writes a car energy/fuel value ([car+0x540]+0x100, from +0xb60) and increments a per-car counter when mode==1; name covers only tyre wear.
